## Message

```
error X18N4002: Rename target already exists: <detail>
  Delete or rename the existing key first.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A rename target already exists in at least one locale. x18n does not merge two keys.

1. Run `x18n get <to>` to see the existing key.
2. Delete or rename it first, then run the rename again.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
